strategy.thesis: Cross-border Taiwan-Japan biotech funds run by DCI Partners (the life-science VC arm of Japan's Daiwa Securities Group, formerly NIF), created with National Development Fund and Japan's SME Support agency; invests 100% in biotech/medical (生技醫療), supporting portfolio companies with drug-development, IP and licensing networks across Taiwan and Japan.

summary.en: DCI Partners (Daiwa Securities Group's life-science VC) runs two Taiwan-Japan cross-border biotech funds — Fund I (¥11.6B / ~NT$2.44B, 2015) and Fund II (¥15.3B / ~NT$3.21B, 2021) — investing 100% in biotech/medical and bridging the Taiwanese and Japanese biopharma ecosystems.
summary.local: DCI Partners(大和證券集團旗下生技創投,前身NIF)管理兩支台日跨境生技基金:一號(116億日圓/約24.38億台幣,2015)、二號(153億日圓/約32.13億台幣,2021),100%投資生技醫療,鏈結台日生醫產業。

name.local: 維梧資本 Vivo Panda 基金

strategy.thesis: The Taiwan-dedicated fund of Vivo Capital, a global healthcare-only investment firm; Vivo Panda invests 100% in biotech/medical, deploying pharma and medical-device capital into Taiwanese companies and connecting them to Vivo's US and Greater-China platform.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Part of Vivo Capital's global platform (Fund IX, Vivo Opportunity crossover fund, Vivo Innovation Fund), ~US$70B+ managed globally per company materials.

summary.en: Vivo Panda Fund (US$100M / ~NT$3.2B, 2016) is Vivo Capital's Taiwan-dedicated healthcare fund investing 100% in biotech/medical; Vivo, founded 1996 with a Taipei office since 2015, is a global healthcare-only investor and also launched Taiwan's first biotech private-equity fund with Cathay United Bank in 2023.
summary.local: Vivo Panda基金(1億美元/約32億台幣,2016)為維梧資本(Vivo Capital)在台灣的專屬醫療基金,100%投資生技醫療;維梧1996年成立、2015年設台北據點,並於2023年偕國泰世華推出全台首檔生技私募股權基金。

strategy.thesis: Early-stage Taiwan-US biotech VC investing 100% in biotech/medical (生技醫療); backs early biotech and pharmaceutical startups in the US and Taiwan, with a portfolio spanning US- and Taiwan-listed companies.

summary.en: Hercules Bioventure (Fund II US$22.6M / ~NT$723M, 2023) is an early-stage Taiwan-US biotech VC (manager Hercules BioVenture Partners, led by Lee Chia-jung) investing 100% in biotech; its Taiwan entity is based in Taipei and it has backed US- and Taiwan-listed biotech companies.

name.local: 益鼎生技創業投資股份有限公司

current_fund.raw: 登記資本額 新台幣8億元 (實收8億元)

strategy.thesis: Dedicated biotech vehicle within the Yiding (TOP Taiwan) venture group, one of Taiwan's largest generalist VC managers (250+ portfolio companies); the bio arm invests in biotech/medical new drugs and the broader health economy, partnering with healthcare operators such as Sheng Hong and Great Tree Pharmacy.

summary.en: Yiding Bio Venture Capital (registered capital NT$800M) is the dedicated biotech arm of the Yiding / TOP Taiwan venture group — a major generalist VC manager with 250+ investments — targeting biotech/medical new drugs and the wider health economy; past biotech exits include Xing-Guo (杏國) and EBM Technologies (環瑞醫).
summary.local: 益鼎生技創業投資(登記資本額8億元)為益鼎創投集團(TOP Taiwan,綜合型大型創投、投資逾250家)旗下專屬生技投資公司,聚焦生技醫藥新藥與大健康;過往生技退出案含杏國新藥、環瑞醫。
